structured_output.what_is_happening: A real, current news event: Trump is unveiling america.gov, an AI tool to help people navigate federal government websites, at an event with Vance, Rubio, Oz, Gebbia and Musk. That set off a burst of copycat 'america.gov' tokens. This one (6Tr6…) was deployed on the Meteora virtual curve and migrated right away, about 13 minutes before detection. It is at least the fourth same-name clone launched this hour. The leader, pwfAe…, launched about 1.5h earlier and sits at a $1.57M market cap with $2.2M of h1 volume. This clone peaked near $178k and is now down 45% in 5 minutes at about $72k, with more sells than buys.

narrative.description: Trump's official launch of the america.gov AI government portal, with Musk present. A mainstream political and tech news event happening today.
narrative.why_spreading: A high-profile live government launch featuring Trump and Musk is classic memecoin-narrative fuel. Many clones are already trading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the same name and ticker, and its linked X post (alx/status/...) is probably a news post, not a project account. Nothing makes it canonical. It is a late clone.
token_connection.competing_tokens: pwfAe… ($1.57M mcap, $137k liq, launched ~1.5h earlier, clearly the leader); JE2Ns… ($305k); 3hysk… ($113k); plus older pump.fun America.gov tokens.

authenticity.evidence: 1116 unique buyers vs 115 sellers in about 13 minutes. GMGN tags 81 of the wallets as bundlers. The creator holds 17.77% of supply. No paid boosts and no DexScreener profile. Most likely this is spillover from the narrative plus clone-sniping bots.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is inaccessible (402), so I could not check whether anyone is promoting this specific contract address.

structural_risks: Creator wallet holds 17.77% of supply and can dump it
Price is already down 45% in m5 from the ATH; sells outnumber buys
The canonical token is sucking up the narrative's liquidity
RugCheck flags low liquidity (the pool is probably mislabeled); the 80% holder is likely the pool

structured_output.counterargument: The event is live and very large, with Trump and Musk on stage. Clones sometimes run 2-3x on a second wave of news. At $72k with $26k of liquidity, a small burst of buyers could double it. LP is burned and mint/freeze are renounced.
unknowns: What the linked X post contains
Whether the creator is about to sell the 17.77%
Whether a later news wave will lift all the clones

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. The news search confirmed the america.gov launch event. The X fetch returned 402. I did not search Reddit, Telegram or Discord, and did not fetch the website: it is the real government site and has no connection to the token.

structured_output.thesis: The narrative is real and strong, but this is a late fourth-plus clone that is already dumping. The creator holds 17.77% and there are many bundlers. The canonical pwfAe token takes most of the attention. Low odds of running.
